modules.title: Introduction to Islamic Law (Shari'ah)
modules.html:
The sources of Shari'ah -- Qur'an, Sunnah, Ijma and Qiyas -- and its main categories and objectives. This section covers introduction to islamic law (shari'ah).

Key points

  • The primary source of Islamic Law (Shari'ah) is the _____. — Qur'an.
  • In Islamic Law, the gift given by a groom to the bride at the time of marriage is... — Mahr (Sadaq).
  • The primary source of Islamic law is the — Qur’an.
  • The study of Islamic Law is called — Fiqh.
  • In Shari'ah, the prohibited acts are known as _____. — Haram.

Worked examples

Q: The primary source of Islamic Law (Shari'ah) is the _____.
A: Qur'an — The Qur'an is the ultimate and most authoritative source of guidance in Islam, followed by the Sunnah/Hadith.

Q: In Islamic Law, the gift given by a groom to the bride at the time of marriage is...
A: Mahr (Sadaq) — Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Mahr (Sadaq).

quiz.q: The primary source of Islamic Law (Shari'ah) is the _____.
quiz.solution: The Qur'an is the ultimate and most authoritative source of guidance in Islam, followed by the Sunnah/Hadith.

quiz.q: In Islamic Law, the gift given by a groom to the bride at the time of marriage is...
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Mahr (Sadaq).

quiz.q: The primary source of Islamic law is the?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Qur’an.

quiz.q: The study of Islamic Law is called?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Fiqh.

quiz.q: In Shari'ah, the prohibited acts are known as _____.
quiz.solution: Haram refers to anything explicitly forbidden by Allah and His Messenger.

quiz.q: Which of these is NOT a source of Shari'ah?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Philosophy.

quiz.q: The 4th Caliph was the Prophet's cousin and son-in-law?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Ali ibn Abi Talib.

quiz.q: The 'Battle of the Trench' is also known as the Battle of _____.
quiz.solution: It is called 'Al-Ahzab' because various tribes formed a confederacy to attack the Muslims in Madinah.

quiz.q: The 'Takbirat al-Ihram' is the _____.
quiz.solution: This Takbir signals the entry into the sacred state of prayer, during which ordinary actions like eating or talking become forbidden.

quiz.q: The Surah that must be recited in every Rak'ah of prayer is _____.
quiz.solution: Prayer is invalid without the recitation of Al-Fatihah, known as 'Umm al-Kitab'.

quiz.q: The companion known as 'Dhul-Nurayn' (The possessor of two lights) was _____.
quiz.solution: Uthman b. Affan was given this title because he married two of the Prophet's daughters, Ruqayyah and Umm Kulthum.

quiz.q: The ruler of Abyssinia who protected the early Muslim migrants was _____.
quiz.solution: The Negus (Najashi) was the Christian King of Abyssinia who provided refuge to Muslims fleeing Makkan persecution.

quiz.q: Quran revealed over:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: 23 years.

quiz.q: Salat is performed:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: 5 times.

quiz.q: Ghusl is:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Full bath.

quiz.q: Fourth Caliph:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Ali.

quiz.q: Book of Isa:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Injil.

quiz.q: Eid al-Adha marks:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Sacrifice/Hajj.

quiz.q: Which wife of the Prophet was known as 'Mother of the Believers'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Khadijah.

quiz.q: The Farewell Pilgrimage of the Prophet took place in:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: 10 AH.

quiz.q: Which Surah does not start with Bismillah?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Surah Al-Tawbah.

quiz.q: The first Caliph was:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Abu Bakr.

quiz.q: Who compiled the Quran into a book?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: Uthman.

quiz.q: The Treaty of Hudaybiyyah was a truce for:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2023). Correct answer: 10 years.

quiz.q: How many daily prayers are obligatory for a Muslim?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Five.

quiz.q: Which Sahaba was known as 'Dhul-Nurayn' (Possessor of two lights)?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Uthman.

quiz.q: The daily prayer performed before sunrise is:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Fajr.

quiz.q: Riba (Usury/Interest) is:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Forbidden (Haram).

quiz.q: The last sermon of the Prophet was delivered at:
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2025). Correct answer: Mount Arafat.

quiz.q: Kalimat ash-Shahadah is:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: La ilaha illallah....

quiz.q: Battle of Badr was a:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Victory for Muslims.

quiz.q: Akhirah means:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Hereafter.

quiz.q: Eid al-Adha involves:
quiz.solution: Past question (NECO 2025). Correct answer: Sacrifice of animal.

quiz.q: Madinan Surahs:
quiz.solution: Past question (WAEC 2025). Correct answer: Laws/Society.

quiz.q: Ghusl:
quiz.solution: Past question (WAEC 2025). Correct answer: Bath.

quiz.q: Musa Book:
quiz.solution: Past question (WAEC 2025). Correct answer: Tawrat.

quiz.q: Adha:
quiz.solution: Past question (WAEC 2025). Correct answer: Sacrifice.

quiz.q: Tawhid ar-Rububiyyah refers to the oneness of Allah in His?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Lordship/Creation.

quiz.q: The funeral prayer is known as?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Salat al-Janazah.

quiz.q: Hajj is compulsory for those who?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Are physically and financially able.

quiz.q: Prophet 'Isa (AS) was born to?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Maryam.

quiz.q: At age 25, he married?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Khadijah.

quiz.q: Makkah was conquered in the year ___ A.H.?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: 8.

quiz.q: IRK is a study that helps in?
quiz.solution: Past-question bank (legacy TXT). Correct answer: Moral and spiritual guidance.
